channel.title: Joe Hartmann Finds
channel.description: Joe Hartmann Finds is a growing collection of Amazon affiliate finds from Joe Hartmann's Pinterest boards, each with a short article and links to the pin and to Amazon.

item.title: Oversized Wearable Blanket Sweatshirt – Giant Blanket Hoodie for Women & Men
item.description: A look at an oversized wearable blanket sweatshirt with a big plush hood, roomy sleeves, and a giant front pocket, long enough to keep you warm from head to legs on cold nights.

item.title: Women's Fluffy Fleece Pajama Set – Cozy Ribbed Pullover & Pants PJs
item.description: A look at a women's two-piece fleece pajama set with a long sleeve crew neck pullover, ribbed cuffs and collar, and matching full-length pants with an elastic waistband.

item.title: Amazon Essentials Men's Fleece Open Bottom Sweatpants – Comfy Lounge Pants
item.description: A look at the Amazon Essentials men's fleece open bottom sweatpant, with a relaxed straight leg, an elastic drawstring waistband, on-seam side pockets, and Big & Tall sizes.

item.title: The Original Eden Weighted Hoodie Cloak – Plush Faux Fur Lined Wearable Blanket
item.description: A closer look at the Free The Sheep Eden Hoodie, an oversized unisex hoodie cloak with a soft 4 lb interior weight and a full plush faux fur lining for lounging, reading, and travel.

item.title: Women's Oversized Cable Knit Cardigan – Cute Sheep Embroidered Button V-Neck Sweater
item.description: A look at a women's cable knit open front cardigan with sheep embroidery, a V-neck, rainbow buttons, two side pockets, and a relaxed, hip-length fit for fall and winter.

item.title: Trendy Queen Women's Oversized Cable Knit Sweater – Chunky Crewneck Pullover
item.description: A closer look at the Trendy Queen Women's Oversized Cable Knit Sweater, a cotton-blend crewneck pullover with a classic cable knit pattern and a relaxed, oversized fit for fall and winter layering.

item.title: PRETTYGARDEN Women's Chunky Cable Knit Cardigan – Oversized Button Sweater Coat
item.description: A closer look at the PRETTYGARDEN Women's Chunky Cable Knit Cardigan, a loose-fit button-front sweater with twist cable texture, ribbed cuffs and hem, and pockets.

item.title: Amazon Essentials Women's Fleece Quarter-Zip Pullover Sweatshirt – Cozy Everyday Layer
item.description: A closer look at the Amazon Essentials Women's Long-Sleeve Fleece Quarter-Zip Pullover, a classic-fit cotton-blend sweatshirt with a mock neck, a quarter zip, and a kangaroo pocket.

item.title: AUTOMET Women's 2 Piece Lounge Set – Oversized Hoodie & Jogger Matching Sweat Set
item.description: A closer look at the AUTOMET Women's 2 Piece Lounge Set, a matching cotton-polyester fleece sweat set with a drop-shoulder hoodie and relaxed joggers with side pockets.

item.title: AUTOMET Women's Half Zip Fleece Pullover – Oversized Cropped Sweatshirt Fall Outfit
item.description: A closer look at the AUTOMET Women's Half Zip Fleece Pullover, a relaxed, drop-shoulder sweatshirt with a soft fleece lining, a half-zip stand collar, thumb holes, and a front kangaroo pocket.

item.title: G Gradual Women's Fleece Lined Joggers – Warm Water-Resistant Winter Pants
item.description: A closer look at G Gradual Women's Fleece Lined Joggers, thermal winter pants with a water-resistant coating, a 4-inch high waistband with drawcord, a tapered cut, and two zipper pockets.

item.title: Hanes Men's EcoSmart Fleece Joggers – Soft Lounge Sweatpants With Pockets
item.description: A closer look at Hanes Men's EcoSmart Fleece Joggers, midweight cotton and polyester fleece sweatpants with a relaxed fit, a functional drawcord, side-seam pockets, and a back pocket.

item.title: Fuzzy Cloud Socks for Women – Cozy Slipper Socks and Stocking Stuffer Gift
item.description: A closer look at Unboxme Gifts Fuzzy Cloud Socks for women, plush polyester knit slipper socks in one size that fits most, packed in a cotton drawstring gift bag.

item.title: RockDove Women's Faux Shearling Closed-Back House Slipper – Memory Foam
item.description: A closer look at the RockDove Women's Faux Shearling Closed Back Slipper, with a faux shearling feel, a back pull loop, a quiet non-slip rubber sole, and a memory foam footbed.

item.title: Litfun Fuzzy Faux Fur Slippers for Women – Memory Foam Indoor House Shoes
item.description: A closer look at Litfun's fuzzy slippers for women, with a faux fur and coral fleece lining, a plush collar, a faux suede upper, a memory foam footbed, and a non-slip sole.

item.title: EverFoams Women's Soft Curly Memory Foam Slippers – Cozy Fleece-Lined House Shoes
item.description: A closer look at EverFoams Women's Soft Curly Slippers, lightweight loafer-style house shoes with a faux wool upper, polar fleece lining, a high-density memory foam insole, and a non-slip sole.

item.title: Barefoot Dreams CozyChic Adult Robe – Ultra Soft Plush Unisex Bathrobe
item.description: A closer look at the Barefoot Dreams CozyChic Adult Robe, a soft, lightweight, unisex robe in 100% polyester microfiber CozyChic knit with a shawl collar, a tie closure, and machine-washable care.

item.title: Bedsure Long Sherpa Wearable Blanket Hoodie – Full-Length Hooded Blanket, Grey
item.description: A closer look at the Bedsure Long Sherpa Wearable Blanket Hoodie, an extra-long sherpa fleece hooded blanket with a side slit, an adjustable waist belt, deep side pockets, and ribbed cuffs in three sizes.

item.title: Krifey Wearable Blanket Hoodie – Oversized Sherpa Hooded Blanket for Adults
item.description: A closer look at the Krifey wearable blanket hoodie, an oversized flannel fleece and sherpa hooded blanket with roomy sleeves, a giant pocket, OEKO-TEX STANDARD 100 certified fabric, and machine-washable care.

item.title: THE COMFY Original Wearable Blanket Hoodie – Shark Tank Oversized Sherpa Hoodie
item.description: A closer look at THE COMFY Original, the patented oversized wearable blanket hoodie from Shark Tank with a Velveluxe microfiber outside, CloudSherpa lining, a giant pocket, and ribbed cuffs.

item.title: Gerber Ultimate Fixed Blade Knife – Survival Knife With Sheath, Sharpener & Ferro Rod
item.description: A closer look at the Gerber Ultimate fixed blade survival knife, with a half-serrated drop point blade, rubber grip, hammer pommel, emergency whistle, and a sheath that holds a sharpener and ferro rod fire starter.

item.title: Magnetic Levitating Floating Globe With LED Lights – Cool Tech Desk Gadget Gift
item.description: A closer look at the Poojaed magnetic levitating floating globe with LED lights, a desk gadget where the globe floats in midair inside its frame and can spin for 15 to 25 minutes after a push.

item.title: LEGO Icons Ford Model T 11376 – Vintage Car Building Set for Adults
item.description: A closer look at the LEGO Icons Ford Model T (11376), a 1,060-piece vintage car building set for adults with a foldback roof, fold-down windshield, working steering, and a crank that spins the fan.

item.title: LEGO Technic Ferrari FXX K Building Set – Collectible Supercar Model Kit
item.description: A closer look at the LEGO Technic Ferrari FXX K (42212), an 897-piece supercar model with butterfly doors, an opening hood, a V12 engine with moving pistons, and a working differential.

item.title: LEGO Technic Fast and Furious Toyota Supra MK4 Building Kit – Car Model Set
item.description: A closer look at the LEGO Technic Fast and Furious Toyota Supra MK4 (42204), an 810-piece car model kit with a 6-cylinder engine, steering, opening hood, removable Targa top, and NOS bottles in the trunk.

item.title: Indoor Putting Green Golf Putting Mat – Crystal Velvet Practice Green for Home & Office
item.description: A closer look at the YOUCZON indoor putting green, a crystal velvet putting mat with a solid wood build, gradient alignment lines, an automatic ball return, magnetic tracks, and practice distances from 2 to 7.5 feet.

item.title: LEGO Technic Koenigsegg Jesko Absolut Grey Hypercar 42173 – Car Model Set
item.description: A closer look at the LEGO Technic Koenigsegg Jesko Absolut Grey Hypercar (42173), an 801-piece set with a moving V8 engine, differential, steering, and dihedral synchro-helix doors.

item.title: Arcade1Up Ms. Pac-Man Class of '81 Deluxe Home Arcade Machine – 12 Retro Games
item.description: A closer look at the Arcade1Up Ms. Pac-Man Class of '81 Deluxe Arcade, a full-size home cabinet with 12 classic games, a 17-inch BOE LCD screen, Wi-Fi leaderboards, and a light-up marquee.

item.title: LEGO Technic 2022 Ford GT 42154 – Collectible Supercar Building Set for Adults
item.description: A closer look at the LEGO Technic 2022 Ford GT (42154), a 1:12 scale model car kit for adults with a V6 engine with moving pistons, independent suspension, front-axle steering, and opening doors.

item.title: DJI Mini 3 – Lightweight 4K Camera Drone With 3-Axis Gimbal, Under 249 g
item.description: A closer look at the DJI Mini 3, a foldable mini camera drone under 249 g with a 3-axis mechanical gimbal, 4K HDR video, True Vertical Shooting, and up to 10 km HD video transmission.

item.title: Whiskey Smoker Kit With Torch – 6 Wood Chip Flavors, 2 Glasses & Ice Ball Molds
item.description: A closer look at the ComboJoy whiskey smoker kit with a torch, oak cocktail smoker top, six natural wood chip flavors, two glasses, and two ice ball molds for smoky drinks at home.

item.title: Solo Stove Bonfire w/Stand – 19.5" Smokeless Wood Burning Fire Pit, Stainless
item.description: A closer look at the Solo Stove Bonfire 2.0 with Stand, a 19.5-inch stainless steel wood-burning fire pit with a 360° airflow design, removable ash pan, stand, and carry case.

item.title: NERF Elite 2.0 Commander RD-6 Dart Blaster – 6-Dart Rotating Drum, 12 Darts
item.description: A closer look at the NERF Elite 2.0 Commander RD-6, a pump-action foam dart blaster with a 6-dart rotating drum, slam fire, 12 Elite darts, and tactical rails.

item.title: TempPro TempSwift Instant Read Meat Thermometer – 1-Second Digital Grill Thermometer
item.description: A closer look at the TempPro TempSwift TP19H, an instant-read digital meat thermometer with a foldaway stainless probe, auto-rotating backlit display, IP65 water resistance, and a magnetic back.

item.title: Gerber Suspension NXT 15-in-1 Multitool – EDC Pliers, Knife & Screwdrivers
item.description: A closer look at the Gerber Suspension NXT, a stainless steel 15-in-1 multitool with needle nose pliers, a partially serrated blade, scissors, screwdrivers, and a pocket clip for everyday carry.

item.title: OGGI Beer Tower 3L/100oz Beverage Dispenser With Spigot & Ice Tube for Parties
item.description: A closer look at the OGGI Beer Tower, a 3-liter (100 oz) beverage dispenser with an EZ-Pour spigot, a removable ice tube, and a chrome-plated steel base for beer, margaritas, and more.

item.title: Kershaw Cryo Pocket Knife – SpeedSafe Assisted Opening EDC Folding Knife
item.description: A closer look at the Kershaw Cryo, a compact stainless steel folding knife designed with Rick Hinderer, with assisted opening, a 2.75-inch 8Cr13MoV blade, and a four-position pocket clip.

item.title: Gerber Dime 12-in-1 Mini Multitool – Keychain Pliers, Knife & Bottle Opener
item.description: A closer look at the Gerber Dime, a 2.2-ounce, 12-in-1 mini multitool with spring-loaded needle nose pliers, a blade, scissors, a bottle opener, and more, small enough for a keychain.

item.title: Gerber Multi-Plier 600 – 14-in-1 One-Hand Opening Multitool With Sheath, Black
item.description: A closer look at the Gerber Multi-Plier 600, a 14-in-1 stainless steel multitool with patented one-hand opening needlenose pliers, Saf.T.Plus locking, and an included sheath.

item.title: Kershaw Leek Pocket Knife – Assisted Opening EDC Knife, 14C28N Steel
item.description: A closer look at the Kershaw Leek, a slim assisted-opening pocket knife with a 3-inch Sandvik 14C28N blade, a frame lock with tip-lock slider, and a reversible pocket clip.

item.title: Sony BRAVIA Theater Bar 9 – 13-Speaker Dolby Atmos Soundbar for Home Theater
item.description: A closer look at the Sony BRAVIA Theater Bar 9 (HT-A9000), a 13-speaker soundbar with Dolby Atmos, DTS:X, IMAX Enhanced, 360 Spatial Sound Mapping, HDMI 2.1 features, and wireless music streaming.

item.title: Shure MV7i USB-C Smart Microphone – Podcast & Zoom Mic With Built-In Interface
item.description: A closer look at the Shure MV7i, a USB-C smart microphone with a built-in interface, an XLR/¼-inch combo input for a second channel, Voice Isolation Tech, Auto Level Mode, and an LED touch panel.

item.title: Bose SoundLink Max – Large Waterproof Portable Bluetooth Speaker, 20-Hour Battery
item.description: A closer look at the Bose SoundLink Max, a large portable Bluetooth speaker with IP67 water and dust resistance, up to 20 hours of battery, USB-C and AUX inputs, and Bose app control.

item.title: Kindle Scribe Colorsoft 32GB – 11-Inch Color E-Ink Tablet for Notes & Reading
item.description: A closer look at the Amazon Kindle Scribe Colorsoft (32GB), with an 11-inch paper-like color display, a pen included, a built-in notebook, AI note tools, and Google Drive and OneDrive import.

item.title: Apple Watch Series 11 GPS 46mm – Jet Black Aluminum Smartwatch for Men
item.description: A closer look at Apple Watch Series 11 (GPS, 46mm) in Jet Black aluminum, with sleep score, health and fitness tracking, safety features, and up to 24 hours of normal battery use.

item.title: DJI Mic 2 (2 TX + 1 RX) – Wireless Lavalier Microphone System with Charging Case
item.description: A closer look at the DJI Mic 2 wireless microphone kit with two transmitters, a receiver, and a charging case, featuring intelligent noise cancelling, 32-bit float internal recording, and long range.

item.title: Apple MagSafe Charger (2 m) – Fast Wireless Charger for iPhone & AirPods
item.description: A closer look at Apple's 2-meter MagSafe Charger, which snaps magnetically onto MagSafe iPhones for faster wireless charging up to 25W and also works with Qi and Qi2 devices like AirPods wireless cases.

item.title: Oral-B iO Series 8 Electric Toothbrush – Smart Display, Pressure Sensor & Travel Case
item.description: A closer look at the Oral-B iO Series 8 rechargeable toothbrush, with iO magnetic technology, six cleaning modes, a colored interactive display, a smart pressure sensor, and a travel case.

item.title: Hyperice Hypervolt Go 2 – Lightweight Percussion Massage Gun for Recovery
item.description: A closer look at the Hyperice Hypervolt Go 2, a compact, cordless percussion massage gun with QuietGlide technology, three speeds, and a travel-friendly design.

item.title: JBL Charge 6 – Portable Waterproof & Dropproof Bluetooth Speaker, Black
item.description: A closer look at the JBL Charge 6, a waterproof, dustproof, and dropproof Bluetooth speaker with AI Sound Boost, Auracast multi-speaker pairing, and a built-in powerbank.
